chart.alt: Two pie charts showing how a typical family’s weekly food budget was divided. 1985: meat and fish 27%, bread and cereals 18%, eating out 18%, fruit and vegetables 15%, dairy and eggs 14%, ready meals and snacks 8%. 2025: meat and fish 19%, bread and cereals 11%, eating out 25%, fruit and vegetables 17%, dairy and eggs 9%, ready meals and snacks 19%.

document.title: A family food budget in 1985 and 2025
document.question:
